Plasma Storm

Released February 6, 2013 · 138 cards

Expanded

Plasma Storm is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on February 6, 2013. Its main set has 135 cards, plus 3 secret rares numbered beyond the set (138 in total). It includes 122 Pokémon, 15 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

33 illustrators worked on Plasma Storm. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (32), Kouki Saitou (8), match (7), Akira Komayama (6), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Ryo Ueda (6), Shin Nagasawa (6), Toyste Beach (6).
